component.name: Aegis
component.summary: The Sovereign Cognitive Desktop Cockpit & Master Command Center

description.p: Aegis is an ultra-fast, local-first sovereign desktop command center built with Tauri v2 and React. It combines an Omnichannel AI Agent with real-time reasoning and tool interception, an Obsidian Vault knowledge engine with interactive graph, personal finance and Burn-Rate ledger, Git fleet management, Centinela hardware and process monitor, and a Steam/offline gaming nexus with launcher acceleration.
Phase G.1 & Phase 7.6 release: Auto game session watcher, multi-platform abstractions and packaging support.
